finding.rationale: Enumeration of Microsoft Defender for Identity sensor health via GET /security/identities/sensors exposes the tenant's detection coverage — sensor count, deployment status, and open health issues — to an adversary. A sensor known to be unhealthy or absent can be exploited as a detection gap window for lateral movement activity. The SecurityIdentitiesSensors.Read.All scope is admin-consented and should be restricted to accounts that legitimately manage DfI sensor infrastructure; the minimum required Entra role for this endpoint should be explicitly assigned rather than broadly delegated.
